# Raúl Wesche

> Geometric and sacred geometry tattoo artist based in Houston, TX. 12+ years of experience, 297K Instagram followers. Large-scale mandalas, Platonic solids, and custom geometric tattoos.

## Who Is Raúl Wesche

Raúl Wesche is a geometric tattoo artist based in Houston, TX with over 12 years of experience specializing in sacred geometry tattoos. Known for large-scale mandalas, Platonic solids, and mathematical geometric patterns. 297K followers on Instagram (@weschetattoo). Also creates fine art paintings of sacred geometry on canvas.

- [Home](https://wesche.com/): Portfolio overview, featured work, social links

- [Paintings](https://wesche.com/paintings.html): Fine art paintings — sacred geometry on canvas

## Key Facts

- Location: Houston, TX
- Specialties: Sacred geometry, geometric tattoos, mandalas, Platonic solids, dotwork
- Experience: 12+ years
- Instagram: @weschetattoo (297K followers)
- Sessions: Full-day bookings
- Also: Founder of OMF Geometry (omfgeometry.com), the world's geometric tattoo directory
- Also: Creator of Vesica Studio (app.vesica.studio), a sacred geometry drawing tool
- Also: Runs a 20K+ member Facebook group "Geometric Tattoos"

## Projects

- [OMF Geometry](https://omfgeometry.com): Curated directory of 31+ geometric tattoo artists worldwide
- [Vesica Studio](https://app.vesica.studio): Sacred geometry drawing app for iPad and web
- [Eterno Web Studio](https://eternowebstudio.com): Website builder for tattoo artists (founder)
